label: Pot-Limit Omaha · 6-max
description: Spot-first studies for six-max Pot-Limit Omaha, built on the dimensions a four-card game turns on: SPR, multiway state, board suit structure, pairing and connectivity, sizing and effective stack. No 13x13 range grid and no hand-state panels: neither has a correct four-card meaning here.
